pages.title: Princess Peach and Daisy Dressed as Mario and Luigi Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Princess Peach dressed as Mario and Princess Daisy as Luigi, posing together in their signature lettered caps, short overalls, and gloves.
